svg.title: Heltec V4.3 R2 Audio Wiring - Rev B
svg.desc: Precise revision of the editable project schematic. GPIO40 replaces GPIO15 for BCLK; GPIO41 replaces GPIO16 for LRC. No added connections on the four top GPIO pads. Proposed USB-only wiring; hardware verification pending.

svg.title: Heltec V4.3 R2 wiring schematic, revision B
svg.desc: Amplifier BCLK uses GPIO40 and word select uses GPIO41. Other original schematic connections are unchanged.

g.text: Heltec V4.3 R2 - Audio wiring (Rev B)

g.text: STANDARD V4.3 / ESP32-S3R2 ONLY. Firmware port and hardware checks are still pending.
All GND symbols join the same ground. R1 goes from SD to GND, not in series with GPIO48.
Unplug L76 GPS/GNSS and expansion accessories. GPIO38-41 are used by audio / PTT.
BCLK = GPIO40; LRC / WS = GPIO41. No added wires on top GPIO15-18. See locator below.
Physical pin locator - display facing you, USB-C at bottom
GPIO numbers identify signals. Header positions count upward from USB, with GND at position 1.
Keep the L76 GPS module unplugged.
Do not use this map on V4-R8.
Match module terminal names, not their drawn order. Connect PTT only after GPIO39 is configured as INPUT_PULLUP.
